title: add-benchmark-lab-performance-suites-and-reporting-pipeline-v151
author: Evan Brooks
release_notes: Add v151 performance test suites, memory profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and a reporting pipeline. Backwards-compatible; improves observability and adaptive batching coverage.
description: Motivation: expand the Benchmark Lab to cover new production-representative performance suites and improve telemetry for regression detection. This PR adds v151 performance suites focused on mixed-sequence workloads, memory and cold-start profiling baselines, representative workload runners for streaming and multi-variant tests, and an automated reporting pipeline that uploads results to the reporting DB and triggers dashboard updates.  What changed (summary): - New perf suites: benchmark-lab/suites/perf_v151/* (mixed seq, streaming-heavy, multi-variant) - Memory and cold-start profiling baselines: benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/v151/* - Representative workload runners: benchmark-lab/runners/representative/* (adds streaming and multi-variant runners with config templates) - Reporting pipeline: benchmark-lab/pipeline/reporting-v151 (Airflow DAG + uploader + small API shim) - Observability: observability-pack/telemetry/benchmarks-v151.json (added new metrics and tags) - CI: perf-canary job updated to run quick smoke of v151 suites on PRs and nightlies  Checklist:  - [x] Define test cases and sample prompts for mixed sequence workloads - [x] Add runner implementations (python + shell) and integration tests - [x] Add memory/cold-start baselines and runner harnesses - [x] Wire reporting DAG to upload metrics and artifacts - [x] Add dashboard delta queries for regression alerts - [x] Update CI to include quick canary for v151  Testing & validation: - Local runs of all representative runners against small model on dev GPU (see commits for logs) - Nightly run on benchmark-lab infra for a week with stable results; averages within expected ranges vs. v150 baselines - Perf-canary task exercised on this PR (see CI checks)  Backward compatibility: All changes are additive. Existing v150 and earlier suites are unaffected. Reporting schema extended with optional fields; uploader handles both old and new payloads.  Notes for reviewers: focus on runner correctness (batching and kv-cache warmup), reporting DAG idempotency, and telemetry tag consistency across suites. If approved I will squash & merge; I plan to follow up with a small housekeeping PR to remove a deprecated test harness after two successful nightly runs.
